Walks & Things to Do

Green spaces, independent neighbourhoods and great views.

★ Our favourite walk

Parkland Walk

A beautiful walking route through greenery towards Crouch End and Highgate. Stop at Sourdough Sophia or Udderlicious along the way.
● Directions

Finsbury Park

Boating lake, playgrounds, cafés and plenty of room to walk or picnic.
Directions

Alexandra Palace

Big views, parkland, events and a great day out.
Directions

Crouch End

A lively neighbourhood full of independent cafés, shops and restaurants. Worth wandering without a plan.
